title: Golden FLA/SWF pair harness: structural + visual diff of our SWF vs Flash 8's export
description: DONE (core deliverables). Built: (1) tools/swf-dump — standalone Rust CLI on ruffle's swf crate; decompresses any SWF (FWS/CWS/LZMA), walks tags, emits normalized JSON: char IDs renumbered in first-use order, shapes decoded to moveTo/lineTo/curveTo with absolute coords, fills + line styles decoded, matrices as {scaleX,scaleY,skew0,skew1,translateX,translateY}, DoAction/DoInitAction bytecode as hex, drops non-semantic tags (FileAttributes/Metadata/EnableDebugger/EnableDebugger2/ProductInfo/DebugId/EnableTelemetry). Builds clean (cargo build) and verified against ruffle test SWFs + our own export. (2) tools/golden-diff.mjs + tools/golden-diff.sh — imports a golden FLA via @flash/core loadFla(), compiles via @flash/swf compileDocument(), swf-dumps both ours and the reference, structural-diffs the JSON trees with twip tolerance (default 1 twip), reports per-path mismatches and exits non-zero on diff. Verified end-to-end: PASS on a matching generated FLA/SWF pair, correctly FAILS with precise shape-bounds + coordinate deltas on a mismatched pair. (3) self-determinism.test.ts in @flash/swf — compileDocument() yields byte-identical output across repeated compiles (uncompressed + compressed CWS). Compiler was ALREADY deterministic (fflate deflateSync uses a fixed default level; symbol topo-sort + char-id allocation are stable) so no fix was required. STILL TODO (needs user-supplied assets, cannot be done autonomously): commit real Macromedia Flash 8 golden .fla/.swf pairs under fixtures/golden/ and add a CI gate that runs golden-diff.sh over them; optional Ruffle side-by-side pixel-diff visual layer (reuse visual-oracle infra). NOTE: glyphoutline.test.ts failures in @flash/swf are unrelated WIP from task 0702 (real glyph outlines), not this task.
